license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (official record)
access: Open Access; no-account anonymous S3 listing and file GETs via the officially documented s3://physionet-open/svdb/1.0.0/ route.
official_description: 78 half-hour ECG recordings selected to supplement examples of supraventricular arrhythmias in MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database.

acquisition.zip_direct_route: Official page advertises 52.0 MB ZIP; large generated-zip endpoint stalled in this environment. Full 417-object release was instead fetched anonymously from the documented public S3 bucket and every object verified against its S3 ETag MD5.

task.name: beat-centered binary supraventricular-premature-beat classification
task.positive_label: WFDB annotation symbol S (supraventricular premature beat)
task.other_annotation_symbols: Excluded from binary task; do not remap J/a/V/F/Q or rhythm/noise markers to normal.
task.input: Two physical ECG channels, 128 samples centered at the annotated beat (1 second per channel), flattened to 256 inputs. Drop beats lacking a full context window at record boundaries.
task.split: Deterministic record-disjoint split: sort the 78 record IDs, permute with NumPy default_rng seed 20261023, first 60 records train, next 9 validation, last 9 test. This is not claimed patient-disjoint because patient identity/grouping is not supplied.
task.preprocessing: Per-input-coordinate mean and standard deviation fit on train beat windows only; standard deviations below 1e-6 set to 1.0.

pilot.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU, 6 GiB
pilot.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss with positive weight equal to train negative/positive count
pilot.threshold: max validation positive F1 over 197 thresholds from 0.01 to 0.99; reused unchanged on test
pilot.baseline: Always-normal balanced accuracy 0.5, positive F1 0, and test average precision equal to test prevalence 0.09336.
pilot.readout: Test AP is 0.315–0.481 versus 0.093 prevalence; test balanced accuracy 0.617–0.692 and F1 0.271–0.508 across tested widths. It is non-saturated in these settings, with moderate discrimination; width 512 improves AP/BA/F1. Not a certification across all depths, widths, seeds, or ADP variants.

disposition: KEEP PROVISIONALLY as a supervised beat/event-classification benchmark. The access, license, parser, full-batch RTX 3050 training, and tested non-saturation gates pass. Limitations: record-disjoint but not verified patient-disjoint; only S-vs-N task; one split/seed; only three vanilla configurations; runner and ADP variants not tested.

citations.original_work: Greenwald SD. Improved detection and classification of arrhythmias in noise-corrupted electrocardiograms using contextual information. Ph.D. thesis, Harvard-MIT HST, 1990.
